_comment: Verified-reachable source URLs for Shandong wind/solar plant inventories. All HTTP codes observed from this sandbox on 2026-08-25. Shandong bbox used for clipping: lat 34.25-38.50, lon 114.75-122.75.

sources.name: WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0
sources.notes: Named plant level with real nameplate MW. Vintage ~2018-2021; under-counts post-2020 Chinese buildout.

sources.name: Kruitwagen et al. 2021, A global inventory of solar photovoltaic generating units
sources.notes: Remote-sensing derived PV polygons; capacity_mw is modelled from panel area. Best solar spatial coverage. Snapshot mid-2018.

sources.name: Dunnett et al. 2020, Harmonised global datasets of wind and solar farm locations and power
sources.notes: OpenStreetMap-derived, 2020 snapshot. Good onshore wind point density for Shandong; solar coverage in China is very incomplete.

sources.name: China Offshore Wind Turbine SAR Dataset (COWT-SAR)
sources.notes: Per-turbine offshore locations with installation_year 2020-2025. Most recent offshore coverage found. No capacity - multiply by an assumed turbine rating.

sources.name: DeepOWT / Global offshore wind turbine analysis with Sentinel-1
sources.notes: Per-turbine modelled capacity (pcapacity) and hub height, plus quarterly operating status. Ends 2021Q2, so combine with COWT-SAR for 2022-2025 additions.

rejected.reason: reachable (200) but /catalog/asset-classes has no wind or solar trackers - coal, gas, oil, iron-steel, cement, bioenergy only
reachable (200) but only a 10-plant-per-country capacity-density sample in projected coords; 0 points in Shandong
reachable (200) but country packages are emissions-by-gas only; no renewable nameplate capacity
